note: Planted situations and the result each agent should reach. check_sql runs against the loaded kb schema.

scenarios.title: A big quote has gone quiet
scenarios.situation: Q-1333 to Om Sai Structures (2584199 with tax) was sent three days ago and has not been opened.
scenarios.check_sql: select number, status, opened_at is null as unopened from kb.quotes where organisation_id=1 and number='Q-1333'

scenarios.title: A quote below the margin floor waits for the owner
scenarios.situation: Q-1334 is priced at 2.1% margin; the floor is 3.0%.
scenarios.check_sql: select q.number, q.status, a.status as approval from kb.quotes q join kb.approvals a on a.payload->>'quote'=q.number where q.organisation_id=1 and q.number='Q-1334'

scenarios.title: A payment promise was missed
scenarios.situation: Arihant Fabricators promised 8559911 for 2026-10-17, and nothing has come in.
scenarios.check_sql: select p.name, pr.status, pr.due_date from kb.promises pr join kb.parties p on p.id=pr.party_id where pr.id=20

scenarios.title: The fastest item is about to run out
scenarios.situation: TMT 12mm Fe500D has only a few days of stock left, no purchase order is open, and four supplier rates came in this morning.
scenarios.check_sql: select i.name, m.status, m.days_left from kb.item_metrics m join kb.items i on i.id=m.item_id where m.item_id=3

scenarios.title: A supplier is cheaper than our last buy
scenarios.situation: Tata Tiscon distributor quoted 50558.53 for TMT 12mm Fe500D, 3% below our last purchase at 52122.20.
scenarios.check_sql: select p.name, sq.rate from kb.supplier_quotes sq join kb.parties p on p.id=sq.supplier_id where sq.rfq_id=15 order by sq.rate limit 1

scenarios.title: A regular customer has gone quiet
scenarios.situation: Jai Hind Engineering ordered every 6.4 days and has not ordered since 2026-09-08.
scenarios.check_sql: select p.name, cp.trend, cp.last_order_on from kb.customer_profiles cp join kb.parties p on p.id=cp.party_id where cp.party_id=46

scenarios.title: A good customer has started paying late
scenarios.situation: Arihant Fabricators paid within about a week of the due date for months; bills from the last ~80 days are running over a month late (oldest now 33 days overdue).
scenarios.check_sql: select p.name, cp.previous_grade, cp.grade, cp.avg_days_late from kb.customer_profiles cp join kb.parties p on p.id=cp.party_id where cp.party_id=122

scenarios.title: Money stuck in stock nobody buys
scenarios.situation: MS Plate 6mm (old stock): no sale for 289 days, 1431928 at cost.
scenarios.check_sql: select i.name, m.status, m.idle_days from kb.item_metrics m join kb.items i on i.id=m.item_id where m.item_id=18

scenarios.title: Cash runs short three weeks out
scenarios.situation: A 82121071 bill to JSW Steel - Pune depot (bulk buy) falls due 2026-11-04; the bank balance of 32600000 covers weeks 1-2 but not week 3.
scenarios.check_sql: select week_start, closing_balance from kb.cash_forecast where organisation_id=1 and closing_balance < 0 order by week_start limit 1

scenarios.title: One customer, two ledgers
scenarios.situation: Royal Industrie and Royal Industries share a GSTIN and phone; a bill on the second one is going unchased.
scenarios.check_sql: select count(*) from kb.parties where organisation_id=1 and gstin='27SDVHX9876E1Z7'

scenarios.situation: Owner asks in chat.
